text:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — proposing stable paths + query params for panel state. Regroup left nav: Workspaces / Models / Deployments / Observability / Billing. Add compact breadcrumb row above header, truncate long labels, and use a copy-link that returns a server-canonicalized URL. Thoughts? :mag:

Noah R.: Agree on stable path + params. Engineering notes: avoid back/forward noise — use history.replace for ephemeral UI toggles and history.push for deliberate navigations. Need server middleware to canonicalize shared links and strip dev flags.

Priya D.: A11y nits: announce breadcrumb changes with aria-live polite ("Navigated to Models > model-abc"). Skip-link must land on the active main panel. Breadcrumbs should be keyboard operable — Enter/Space to open. Last crumb gets aria-current="page". Tooltips must be accessible via focus (aria-describedby).

Liam O.: Microcopy: use short labels in the bar with full name in aria-label/tooltip. On mobile collapse into a pill that opens a bottom sheet with full path and a copy action. Toast after copy: "Copied canonical link". Add analytics events: breadcrumb_copy, breadcrumb_navigate.

Maya Chen: Example permalinks: https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=latency&range=24h and https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-abc?revision=7. Shareable params: panel, metric, range, revision. Non-shareable: debug flags, ui_toggles.

Noah R.: Implementation checklist: 1) router middleware for canonicalizePermalink, 2) param whitelist, 3) history manager rules (push vs replace), 4) copy-link endpoint returning canonical URL. I'll spike a prototype middleware.

Priya D.: I'll write accessibility acceptance tests: skiplink landing, breadcrumb Enter navigates, aria-live announcement content, focus restore on close.

Liam O.: I'll post Figma mocks for desktop crumb + mobile pill and three copy variants for the copy tooltip.

AccessibilityBot: Pinned: "NAV-152: Breadcrumb + Permalink accessibility checklist" and scheduled review for next Wed.
